name: train-cs-sk-weighted
description:
RQ6, first full run: GLiNER multilingual fine-tuned for Czech and Slovak names and
addresses with the recall-weighted loss (experiments/loss.py): a missed positive
(span, label) pair costs three times an equally confident false alarm, no focusing.
Weight 3 is focal alpha 0.75's ratio of positive to negative weight (0.75 / 0.25), so
ce, weighted and focal separate the weighting from focal's focusing; at the detector's
threshold 0.3 it reports what a calibrated cross-entropy model would score from about
0.125 up. A first value, tuned on development data against person F2.
Every CNEC 2.0 and UNER Slovak-SNK train example and 10,000 drawn from each OpenPII 1M
train split; 2,000 steps of 16 (about 1.4 passes). Its twin configs differ only in the loss.
